old_caption: The video captures a dance class taking place in a well-lit studio with large mirrors along one wall. The floor is a light beige color, and the walls are painted a neutral beige, creating a calm and focused environment. In the foreground, a woman dressed in a white blouse and black pants is leading the class. She is positioned facing away from the camera, her arms outstretched to the sides as she begins the dance routine. As the video progresses, she raises her arms above her head, then lowers them back down to her sides, demonstrating a series of fluid arm movements. The dancers in the background, reflected in the mirrors, mirror these movements, following the lead of the instructor. The room is equipped with a ballet barre along the wall and a few chairs placed against it, suggesting a space designed for both practice and instruction. The overall atmosphere is one of concentration and discipline, as the participants engage in their choreographed movements.

caption: The video captures a dance studio where a central dancer, viewed from behind in a white long-sleeve top and black cropped pants, performs a port de bras. A full-width mirror wall topped by a tan panel fills the background, with a horizontal wooden barre and two black chairs at the left. At the first frame her arms are already extended outward and upward in a wide diagonal V. Throughout the clip they bend at the elbows, drawing the hands inward and overhead until the forearms form a closed curved frame with the hands crossed above her head. She then holds this overhead position with only small adjustments in the hand angle. The mirror reflects her front and several other dancers in white, pink, and black tops tracing the same trajectory in near synchrony, while partial figures at the far edges also keep their arms raised. Her lower body shifts from an early stance with one foot pointed and lifted to a later flat, turned-out placement. The room, barre, and chairs remain fixed without camera movement.
